source_reference: Schedule V (Criteria for Claims related to Pure)
description: The term 'Pure' or '100% Pure' shall only be used to describe a single ingredient food to which nothing has been added and which is free from avoidable contamination. It shall not be used for composite or multi-ingredient foods with additives.

source: FSSAI (Advertising and Claims) Regulations, 2018 & CCPA Guidelines, 2022
description: Terms such as 'Premium', 'Special', or 'Grade 1' must conform to established grading standards under AGMARK, BIS, or FSSAI commodity regulations.
